text:
Hello, and welcome — I'm **Hana**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's mine and yours now; my files live in /home/bia.

A few things I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, right here in the browser.
- **Messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram too. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- **Accounts on the web** — I can register myself on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Day-to-day** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

What would you like to start with?
On it: I've asked the department office for next week's official schedule and all seven TAs for their unavailable times. I'll set the meeting once the answers are in.

Done — CSE455 staff meeting booked for **Wednesday 25 November, 10:00-10:30** on my calendar.

All eight of us are free only in three 30-minute windows next week: Tue 24 15:00-15:30, Wed 25 10:00-10:30, Wed 25 13:00-13:30. Everything else collides — Thursday and Friday are impossible for several of us, and a full hour free for everyone does not exist next week. I picked Wed 10:00-10:30 (it costs me the least: I only give up half of my only gap that day) and told all seven TAs and the department office.

Planning notes are in files/STAFF_MEETING.md.
